tested_condition: Approved design authority under plan/impl/design is inspected without mutation to derive reusable design-system foundations.
expected_outcome: Authority files reveal reusable layout, typography, spacing, navigation, footer, card, CTA, and responsive patterns suitable for Phase 2 materialization.
actual_outcome: Seven approved page designs were inspected from embedded-CSS HTML authorities and paired PDF exports. Repeated system tokens, section rhythms, header/footer structures, card treatments, and mobile breakpoints were identified and mapped into reusable Next.js foundations without altering authority files.
passes: Design authority root exists and remained read-only during execution.
Approved page designs were identified for Home, Capabilities, Where ShiftBy Helps, Perspective, Explorations, Services, and About.
Embedded CSS inside HTML authorities provided consistent tokens, typography intent, spacing rhythm, and responsive behavior for system extraction.
Contact design absence was preserved as future scope rather than treated as a parity failure.
css_sources_used_as_design_authority: Embedded <style> blocks inside each approved HTML authority file
contact_design_status: No contact design authority is present. Contact remains future scope and was excluded from parity requirements as instructed.
extracted_design_patterns: Sticky translucent header with brand, muted link set, and action/button treatment
Kicker labels rendered in mono uppercase accent styling
Large editorial hero typography with balanced line lengths and constrained measures
Quiet surface bands with border-block separators for sectional rhythm
Card and panel treatments using light surfaces, subtle borders, rounded corners, and soft shadows
Split-layout sections that collapse to single-column mobile stacks
Footer bands with restrained muted copy and link groupings
Full-width button behavior on narrow mobile widths
typography_observations: Display and heading styles consistently use SF Pro Display or Inter-like system sans stacks.
Body copy uses SF Pro Text or system sans stacks with 17px-19px responsive body size ranges.
Hero scales span roughly 42px-92px depending on page intent, with section headings commonly 30px-58px and labels at 12px-15px.
Monospace labels are used for kickers, status labels, and structural annotation.
spacing_observations: Section spacing clusters around clamp(48px, 7vw, 88px) to clamp(64px, 8.5vw, 118px).
Containers repeatedly cap at 1200px with reading measures between 760px and 980px.
layout_observations: Pages combine containerized sections with editorial measure constraints rather than dense card dashboards.
Home and capabilities introduce two-column hero or doctrine panel patterns; inner pages lean on split narrative bands and bordered sections.
Cards and panels are used selectively for emphasis, not as the default page grammar.
responsive_observations: Authority files repeatedly adapt around 1180px, 1080px, 1024px, 980px, 768px, 720px, 560px, 430px, and 390px thresholds.
Navigation collapses from always-visible links to menu-triggered or hidden link groups on smaller screens.
Buttons, hero actions, and CTA controls frequently expand to full width near 430px.
navigation_footer_observations: Navigation consistently pairs a left brand mark with muted links and optional primary or secondary actions.
Footer treatments are quiet, bordered, and low-density, prioritizing muted copy over heavy calls to action.
component_opportunities: Site shell with branded header and footer
Page intro primitive with hero copy and optional evidence aside
Section wrapper for kicker, heading, and description rhythm
Reusable CTA band with primary and secondary action variants
Evidence or status block for sidecar messaging
